name: Bugsink
description: Lightweight, self-hosted error tracker compatible with the Sentry SDK ecosystem.

envVars.description: Django secret key used to sign sessions and tokens
Password for the Bugsink PostgreSQL database user

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://bugsink:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/bugsink"
      SECRET_KEY: {{env.SECRET_KEY}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      CREATE_SUPERUSER: {{env.CREATE_SUPERUSER}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: bugsink
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: bugsink
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
